# Kamil Sikora

## Doctoral Researcher in Linguistics

*Exploring how language shapes cognition, ideology, and social reality.*

I am a doctoral researcher at the University of Wrocław (since October 2026). I investigate political and legislative discourse through cognitive linguistics, corpus-assisted methods, and critical discourse analysis. I am also developing computational workflows for reproducible linguistic research.

[Explore research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Research notes](notes.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary} [GitHub](https://github.com/kws-98){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
